title: Pass over
summary: The camera glides across a component at a low angle, close and tilted at the edges, straight at the centre; a caption rides the pass, in 5 s.

params.name: image
params.description: the component (path); empty draws a placeholder UI

params.name: caption
params.default: One board. Every choice adds up.
params.description: the line that rides the pass

params.name: direction
params.description: enter from the left and leave right, or the reverse

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add pass-over --name my-shot
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-shot/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-shot/scene.html --motion-blur 6
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Only the camera moves; the component is still. Swap `image` for a real screenshot and the pass reads as a product shot.

values.caption: One board. Every choice adds up.

beats.name: Enter
beats.what: low and close at one edge

beats.name: Cross
beats.what: high and straight over the centre; the caption lands

beats.name: Leave
beats.what: low again at the far edge

when: a product surface worth looking at
a quiet establishing shot before the words
